**Download `PulseSetup` below and run it** to install Pulse (no administrator password needed).
Works on any 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 PC.

## Pulse 1.1

**Accounts**
- **Forgot your password?** Press it when signing in: Pulse emails you a 6-digit code, and you choose a new password.
- Sign in with your username or your email address.
- New accounts need an email address. It's only used for password resets and is never shown to anyone. Accounts made before this are asked to add one.
- Change your email in Settings → Account.
- The code email comes from Pulse's Gmail; if it isn't in your inbox, check your spam folder.

**Safer library**
- Pulse keeps a spare copy of your library, saved so it's never left half-written. If your library file is ever damaged (a crash or power cut while saving), Pulse opens the spare copy or the newest backup instead of starting empty, and tells you.

**Discord status**
- Settings shows whether Pulse reached Discord, and why not if it didn't: Discord not open, blocked by Windows (one of them running as administrator), or Discord's own error.

**Fixes**
- Typing a wrong password when changing your password or deleting your account no longer signs you out.
- Big libraries use far less CPU while offline: details that couldn't be looked up are tried again later instead of being forgotten.
- Covers that can't load show the music-note placeholder instead of a red mark.

Everything new in 1.0 is in the [1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/mercy123xz/Pulse/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
